title: Studio — Steps Batumi
description: Studio apartment in the Steps Batumi residential complex. Managed by Steps until November 2026. Address: Batumi, 2b Grigol Lortkipanidze St. 17th floor, 37 m². New Boulevard: near the Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park and Metro City mall. New business-class residential complex with reception and 24/7 security. Amenities include a botanical garden, business centre, restaurant, hotel, parking, children's playground, pool, sauna, hammam, café and gym. About 150 m to the sea, 4 high-speed lifts with backup power, fire safety rooms with oxygen supply. Well suited for living and rental income. Spacious and bright apartment with quality renovation, furniture and appliances. Sea view. Price: $69,000.
